semiconductor_relevance: High — Precitec specializes in precision measurement technologies that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Precitec Laser Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of advanced optical measurement solutions, particularly in the semiconductor sector. Their CHRocodile® product line offers high-precision, contact-free thickness and distance measurements, essential for various semiconductor applications.

regional_presence.China: Precitec has a significant presence in China, with operations in Shanghai to cater to the local semiconductor market.
